mentions.name: Hack
mentions.description: iOS Hacker News client app that has been around for 9 years. This update adds support for iPhone Duo, whose vertical stack menu on the right side is incompatible with the app's original custom-view menu bars and navigation buttons, by switching to iOS native navigation bars and menu bars along with other improvements; it is in final testing ahead of submission to Apple.
mentions.problem: The app's 9-year-old custom view menu bars and navigation buttons do not work well on iPhone Duo because of its vertical stack menu on the right side.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on adding support for iPhone Duo to my hacker news app Hack.
mentions.author: busymom0
